items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: there has never been nobody from Marcus Garvey up that ever loved the black man like Lester Young

ctx.x: I just wondered how you would know about passports.

At that particular time, since I was so close to Lester and since I was relatively close with Norman Granz, I always took care of a lot of things for Les because you must remember, Lester would not go to a doctor or nothing unless he consulted me, because you remember, I buried Lester. His mother, his wife, his sister, and everybody said, 'Jo, you got it,' you see. As I reiterate, there has never been nobody from Marcus Garvey up that ever loved the black man like Lester Young, nobody! Because he was so…
Can you give me any reasons, knowing him as well you did, he called everybody Miss So-and-So or Mr. So-and-So. He called me Miss Hinton.
